$comment: What the world looks like. One colour per terrain class, baked into the map tiles by `npm run world:tile --prefix frontend`. These are not the colours of world/master/terrain.png: those are data, chosen to be far apart so a painted pixel can be read back. These are chosen to sit together. A first pass, to be replaced by the painterly treatment.

colours.$river: Drawn much quieter than a lake. The drainage network is every reach of Strahler order three and up, which is dense enough to read as lace over a whole continent if it is given a lake's colour. Thinning it properly means rebuilding the master with a higher minimum order.
